name: parenthesized-bare-alias
sql: UPDATE items SET name = 'changed' RETURNING (name) version;

name: function-from-operand
sql: UPDATE items SET name = substring(name FROM version + 1);

name: quoted-call-punctuation
sql: UPDATE items SET name = 'changed' RETURNING version "(";

name: quoted-depth-punctuation
sql: UPDATE items SET name = 'changed' RETURNING name AS "(", name version, name;

name: qualified-operator-operand
sql: UPDATE items SET name = 'changed' RETURNING 0 OPERATOR(pg_catalog.+) version;

name: qualified-function-alias
sql: UPDATE items SET name = 'changed' RETURNING public.operator(name) version;

name: unqualified-function-alias
sql: UPDATE items SET name = 'changed' RETURNING operator(name) version;
